desc: Compute the count of numbers with each digit length $d$ in $\{1, \ldots, N\}$, and the sum of numbers with each digit length.
Construct the polynomial $P(z) = \prod_{d=1}^D (1 + 10^d z)^{cnt[d]}$ using binary exponentiation and FFT-based polynomial multiplication.
For each digit length $d$, compute the polynomial $Q_d(z) = P(z) / (1 + 10^d z)$ using the recurrence relation for coefficients.
For each $k$ from $0$ to $N-1$, compute $S_k = \sum_d SumX[d] \times [z^k] Q_d(z)$.
Compute the final answer as $\sum_{k=0}^{N-1} k! (N-1-k)! S_k \pmod{998244353}$.
Implement the solution in Python, using a fast FFT library or implementing NTT for polynomial operations modulo 998244353.
